title: Tech Stack Detector output
description: One dataset item per website, holding the technologies detected on it, the evidence behind each detection, and the DNS-level findings.

results.title: Analyzed websites
results.description: One row per website: detected technologies with category, version and confidence, the header, script, cookie or DNS record that triggered each detection, a category breakdown, server headers and DNS records. Websites that could not be reached appear with ok=false and an error, and are not charged.
